name: Magna Bright

features.text: easy application by hand or high speed and orbital buffers.

description: A one-step polish for use on clearcoat and conventional paints. It removes light oxidation, cleans, polishes and protects. Magna Bright ™ is a thick cream with a peach color.
application: Hand Use: Dampen a clean cloth or applicator and spread Magna Bright ™ on cloth or vehicle surface. Apply product using even pressure and circular motion. Allow to dry. Use a clean towel to wipe clean. Machine Use: Squirt Magna Bright™ onto vehicle surface. For best results, use an all wool finish pad. Apply medium to heavy pressure at first, then gradually ease up until polish dries and develops a gloss. For extended protection and additional gloss, apply a finish wax as a final operation. Can be used with all-wool and foam pads.
